panel.language.title: Server language
panel.language.label: Language
panel.language.auto: Automatic (the language set in Discord for this server)
panel.language.help: Applies to the texts already translated: slash command descriptions, the player and its controls. Texts not translated yet still show in Portuguese. Automatic follows the language set in Discord; without a complete translation it uses English.
panel.language.unknown: Choose a language from the list.
panel.jukebox.options.title: Jukebox options
panel.jukebox.options.auto_delete.label: Delete messages sent in the channel
panel.jukebox.options.auto_delete.help: Text that is not a command goes away after 60 seconds. Commands and the bot's replies stay until the command finishes (on error: 60 more seconds). The Jukebox panel is never deleted.
panel.jukebox.options.text_requests.help: On, any message that does not start with the prefix or with / becomes a request. Off, only commands work: plain text is never executed.
panel.radio.title: Radios
panel.radio.premium.title: Radios in this server
panel.radio.premium.none: This server has no radios enabled. The bot owner is who enables them.
panel.radio.premium.help: Each radio plays on a backup bot, 24 hours a day, in a voice or stage channel. To turn a radio on or off, use /radio in Discord.
panel.radio.list.title: Configured radios
panel.radio.channel_removed: This radio's channel was removed from Discord.
panel.radio.chat.title: Call chat rules
panel.radio.chat.help: The bot deletes messages in this radio's channel: in voice, each one after the time below; on stage, the oldest ones past the maximum or the age. The pinned message, the panel and the bot's notices stay.
panel.radio.chat.voice_delete_after_s: In voice, delete each message after (seconds)
panel.radio.chat.range: Use a whole number from {min} to {max}.
panel.radio.chat.need_permission: To edit the rules you need the Manage Messages permission in this radio's channel.
panel.radio.chat.forbidden: You do not have the permission needed to change this radio.
panel.radio.chat.invalid: The rules sent were not accepted. Reload the page and try again.
panel.radio.unavailable: Radios are not available right now. Try again in a moment.
panel.radio.setup.help: Pick the type, the voice or stage channel and the reserve bot pinned to it. Turning it on and off is done with /radio on and /radio off in Discord.
panel.radio.setup.no_channels: No voice or stage channel available: the bot must be able to connect and speak in it, and the Jukebox channel does not count.
panel.radio.setup.no_bots: No free reserve bot in this server.
panel.radio.setup.created: Radio created. Pick the station below and turn it on with /radio on in Discord.
panel.radio.setup.on_hint: This radio is on: turn it off before changing the channel, the bot or the type.
panel.radio.setup.custom_hint: Live plays a Radio Browser station; custom plays this server's stations (genre and artists depend on the bot's Last.fm key).
panel.radio.setup.full: This server already has the maximum of {max} radios set up.
panel.radio.setup.reset_help: Reset turns the radio off, deletes the call panel and removes the setup (channel, bot, type, chosen stations and chat rules). The server's stations, premium and the other radios stay.
panel.radio.setup.reset_confirm: The radio of bot {bot} in {channel} will be turned off and deleted. This cannot be undone.
panel.radio.setup.token: The confirmation expired or is invalid. Start again.
panel.radio.setup.forbidden.premium: This server has no radios enabled.
panel.radio.setup.forbidden.manage_guild: You need the Manage Server permission to set up radios.
panel.radio.setup.error.kind: Choose the type: live or custom.
panel.radio.setup.error.channel_id: Choose a channel from the list.
panel.radio.setup.error.bot_id: Choose a bot from the list.
panel.radio.setup.error.reserve_only: Only a reserve bot can play a radio.
panel.radio.setup.error.bot_in_call: That bot is in a call of this server right now.
panel.radio.setup.error.one_per_bot: That bot already has a radio in this server.
panel.radio.setup.error.max_radios: This server already has the maximum of radios.
panel.radio.setup.error.channel_kind: The channel must be a voice or stage channel of this server.
panel.radio.setup.error.cannot_connect: The bot cannot connect and speak in that channel.
panel.radio.setup.error.radio_on: Turn the radio off before changing this.
panel.radio.live.title: Live station
panel.radio.live.unknown: station not found in the directory
panel.radio.live.help: When the main station drops, the radio switches to the backup until the main one is back. A radio that is on picks the change at the next station switch, without restarting.
panel.radio.live.search_label: Search a station on Radio Browser
panel.radio.live.search_help: From 2 to 64 characters. Results show below; pick one to be the backup.
panel.radio.live.search_term: Type from 2 to 64 characters to search.
panel.radio.live.search_empty: No station found for that term.
panel.radio.live.invalid: That station cannot be the backup. Pick another one from the list.
panel.radio.live.not_live: Only live radios have a backup station.
panel.radio.live.main_help: Changing the main station switches a radio that is on right away.
panel.radio.live.main_invalid: That station cannot be the main one. Pick another one from the list.
panel.radio.local.title: Pick by location
panel.radio.local.help: Region, country, state and city. The list shows the stations in the city and up to 100 km around it; what is not listed is still reachable by the name search.
panel.radio.local.partial: The directory was slow to answer: the list may be incomplete. Try again in a moment.
panel.radio.local.invalid: That place is no longer in the list. Start from the region.
panel.radio.station.title: Custom stations
panel.radio.station.help: A station is a source of music for the custom radio: one genre, up to 10 artists or up to 5 server playlists. The radio plays in random order, without repeating a track or an artist too soon.
panel.radio.station.lastfm: Genres and artists come from Last.fm.
panel.radio.station.empty: No station yet. Create the first one below.
panel.radio.station.limit: This server already has {max} stations, the maximum.
panel.radio.station.name_label: Name (up to {max} characters, unique in the server)
panel.radio.station.artists: Artists (only with the Artists source; up to {max})
panel.radio.station.artists_help: One per line, up to {max} artists of up to {chars} characters. An artist Last.fm cannot find is marked with ⚠️ and does not play.
panel.radio.station.playlists: Playlists (only with the Playlists source; up to {max})
panel.radio.station.no_playlists: This server has no playlists yet. Add them in the Playlists category.
panel.radio.station.in_use: This station is in use in: {channels}. Change those radios' station before deleting it.
panel.radio.station.error.name_rule: Use 1 to 32 characters, without repeating another station's name in this server.
panel.radio.station.error.kind: Pick a source: genre, artists or playlists.
panel.radio.station.error.genre: Pick a genre from the list.
panel.radio.station.error.artists: Enter 1 to 10 artists, one per line, up to 64 characters each.
panel.radio.station.error.playlists: Check 1 to 5 playlists that exist in this server.
panel.radio.station.error.action: Unknown action. Reload the page and try again.
panel.radio.station.pick_help: The custom radio plays the chosen station. A radio that is on switches right away.
panel.radio.station.pick_none: Create a custom station above to choose it here.
panel.radio.station.pick_invalid: That station no longer exists in this server. Reload the page.
